days.title: Sample: Fruit that lasts
days.introduction: Today is about fruit that lasts. This is sample content standing in for the real Day 9, so the words will change but the shape of the day won’t.
days.scripture_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
days.body_md:
**Sample text.** The real teaching for Day 9 will replace these paragraphs. They are here so the screen has a realistic amount to read on a phone.

Read the passage slowly, twice. The first time, read it for what happens. The second time, notice one word or phrase that stays with you, and sit with it for a moment.

Then think about where *fruit that lasts* shows up in your week: in your studies or work, in how you treat people, and in your time with God.

- What does the passage say?
- What does it ask of you?
- Who could you talk to about it?

Some days need more room. This paragraph stands in for a longer passage of teaching: a story, an example from work or campus life, or a few lines of background on the passage. On a small phone this pushes the page past one screen, which is what we want to test.

You can read the passage in full on [Bible Gateway](https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Galatians%205%3A22-23&version=KJV) if you want more context.
reflection_prompts: What word or phrase from the passage stayed with you, and why?
days.practical_action: Pick one small promise you have made to someone and keep it today, quietly.
days.pod_prompt: Where did today’s theme show up in your week? Keep it short and honest.

days.title: Sample: Rest and look back
days.introduction: Day 16 is for rest, looking back and getting aligned as a pod. No new lesson today. (Sample text: the real words replace this.)
days.scripture_text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
days.body_md:
**Sample text.** Look back over the last seven days. You don’t need to remember everything: notice what stayed with you, and what you want to carry forward.

Take your time with your pod today. Read what others shared and add your own thoughts.
reflection_prompts: What stood out to you most in this module?
What do you want to carry into the next one?
